findings.description: The written plain positive-return clause is not implied by the existing safe-return theorem with its extra SafeThrough hypothesis.

clarifications: CanonicalPair is the original list predicate, not integer realizability; ordinary transport must use an actual pairWord representation.
widthSlope equals the original integer slope sum when original slopes are all nonnegative.
SafeThrough checks 1 <= i <= t via normalization at pair-word time i-1, including the endpoint and excluding initial time zero.
The return equality concerns pair words, not equality to an arbitrarily chosen target integer realizer.
